en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a large, classical-style building with a spacious terrace lined with chairs and tables. The scene appears to be a restaurant or café with people seated outside. There are trees on the right side, suggesting an outdoor garden or park setting. The building features columns and a small cupola or tower on the roof. The caption at the bottom is in Cyrillic script.
